issues: The P03 adapter needs an explicit distinction between named conditional alternatives and exhaustive, mutually exclusive search choices. The existing compiler emits alternatives with choice_group=null and retains the parent continuous family. Chapter 6 explicitly states that allFixed and allFloating do not exhaust alpha in [0,1]. The plan requires mutually exclusive cells but does not specify this distinction or test preservation of the unnamed interior. An adapter that searches only the two named endpoints could pass the proposed debt extrema checks while incorrectly discarding valid histories. Specify parent versus conditional query semantics, preserve overlapping named views without automatic exclusivity, and derive search cells only from genuine choices or a justified exhaustive partition.
